bind_address.description: IP address the Gearman server will listen on (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '::' for IPv6).

bind_port.description: Port number the Gearman server will listen on.

log_file.description: Path to log file (if empty, logs go to stdout/stderr).

worker_timeout.description: Time in seconds before a worker is killed if idle (0 = no timeout).

max_threads.description: Maximum number of concurrent worker threads (per executable).

queue_type.description: Queue backend type. Use 'memory' for in-memory queues, or 'sqlite' for persistent queues.

queue_size.description: Maximum number of jobs to hold in the queue (0 = unlimited). Applies only to queue types that support it (e.g., sqlite).

sqlite_db.description: Path to SQLite database file (required if queue-type=sqlite).

sqlite_queue_table.description: Name of the SQLite table used for the queue.

pid_file.description: Path to PID file for daemon process tracking.

foreground.description: If true, run in foreground (do not daemonize). Useful for debugging or containerized deployment.

function.description: Optional function name the worker handles (e.g., 'reverse'). If omitted, worker handles all functions.

workers.description: List of worker processes to start automatically. Each worker can be scoped to specific function names.
